name: Osmocom Docker Playground
description: Docker containers for the Osmocom cellular telecommunications project. 126 containerized services covering GSM/UMTS infrastructure, SS7/SIGTRAN signaling, and TTCN3 test automation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: 52.8% of repository is Dockerfiles. 126 directories with containerized services including osmo-bsc, osmo-bts, osmo-msc, osmo-sgsn, osmo-hlr, osmo-mgw, osmo-stp, and TTCN3 test suites.

eval_notes: Massive Osmocom Docker ecosystem with 126 containerized telecom components. Covers entire GSM/UMTS stack including SS7 STP, BSC, MSC, HLR. TTCN3 test automation provides built-in evaluation framework.
